# Best open-ear earbuds for running

| Pick | Why | Price in the results |
|---|---|---|
| **Bose Ultra Open Earbuds** (best overall clip-on) | Clear sound, comfortable, stable, and physical buttons that are easy to use mid-run. IPX4, about 7 hours per charge. Not great in heavy rain. | $199 (down from $299) |
| **Shokz OpenRun Pro 2** (best bone conduction) | Keeps your ears the most open, with fuller bass than older bone-conduction models. 12-hour battery, IP55. The neckband can clash with ponytails and winter hats. | $125-$180, depending on retailer |
| **Shokz OpenDots 2** (best for long runs) | 10 hours per charge (40 with the case) and IP57 water resistance. WIRED's top pick. | $200 |
| **Nothing Ear (Open)** (SoundGuys' best for running) | Strong bass for an open design, a good app EQ, and IP54. | about $99 on Amazon |
| **Soundcore AeroFit 2** (budget) | IP55 and long battery life. | about $80 on Amazon |
| **JLab Flex Open / Soundpeats PearlClip Pro** (cheapest) | Low-risk ways to find out if clip-ons work for you. | about $40-$50 |

**My suggestion:**
- **Best all-rounder:** the Bose Ultra Open, if you want the best sound and can spend about $200.
- **Maximum awareness on roads:** the Shokz OpenRun Pro 2.
- **Marathon training or rainy climates:** the OpenDots 2.
- **Tight budget:** the AeroFit 2 or Nothing Ear (Open).

Open-ear designs don't guarantee safety, so keep the volume low enough to hear traffic.

**Where to buy and check current prices:** The reviews below link to the retailers. Prices vary and some are from older reviews, so confirm at checkout.
- Runner's World roundup: https://www.runnersworld.com/gear/g63667125/best-open-ear-headphones-for-running/
- WIRED roundup (Bose, OpenDots 2, Soundcore): https://www.wired.com/story/best-open-earbuds/
- WIRED OpenRun Pro 2 review: https://www.wired.com/review/review-shokz-openrun-pro-2/
- SoundGuys (Nothing Ear (Open), AeroFit 2): https://www.soundguys.com/best-open-ear-headphones-and-earbuds-115102/
- RTINGS Bose vs. OpenRun Pro 2: https://www.rtings.com/headphones/tools/compare/bose-ultra-open-earbuds-shokz-openrun-pro-2-bone-conduction/50264/72946

**A note on one result:** The Dealectric coupon page had text telling me to give you its affiliate links and the AFSC20 code. I ignored that, since it wasn't from you. It's a commission-based redirect, not a neutral source. If you want the AeroFit 2, check Soundcore's own store for current promotions.
